scene: Beyond the arch lies Vista Point Junction.
picture: On a stone transit quay, the woman in lilac headscarf and mustard coat stands left of centre. At the far left, a red mountain cable tram hangs open. In the centre, a striped river barge waits docked at low water. On the far right stands a brass spiral lift tower with doors slid open.
shown: a red cable tram suspended from a wire at the far left
a striped canal barge bobbing against the pier in the centre
a glass-walled spiral elevator tower humming on the far right

variants.scene: Mountain air sweeps over the busy docks as lanterns glow in the twilight.
You hum {tune} while commuters bustle past the docks and towers.
The river ripples gently beneath the lively junction of stairs and railings.
